examples.arabic: انت لازم تجيب اكل صحي معاك في الطريق
examples.english: You must bring healthy food with you on the way
examples.transliteration: enta lazem tigueeb akl sehhi maak fi el tareeq

examples.english: My mother made a lot of healthy food.

examples.arabic: الجدة قالت لا سمك حلو و صحي
examples.english: Grandma said, "No, fish is good and healthy!"
examples.transliteration: El gedda ʾalet laʾ samak ḥelw w seḥḥi.

examples.arabic: ضحكنا وقلنا اهم حاجه اننا بنحب الاكل الصحي حتى لو غالي
examples.english: We laughed and said 'The most important thing is that we love healthy food, even if it's expensive.'
examples.transliteration: Deheknā w olna 'Aham haga ennena benhebb el-akl el-sehhy hatta law ghaly.'

examples.arabic: امي قالت احنا بنحب ناكل اكل صحي
examples.english: My mother said we love to eat healthy food
examples.transliteration: Ommy alet ehna benhebb nakol akl sehhy

examples.arabic: احنا بنحب الاكل الصحي بس لازم نشتري اكتر
examples.english: We love healthy food but we need to buy more.
examples.transliteration: Ehna benhebb elakl elsehhy bas lazim neshtary aktar
